name: @sparkelf/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway
description: Mobile gateway for DSH 0.1.7 (Session format 4). The public entry path is stateless: a dependency-free relay forwards the dsh-mobile-v1 WebSocket to the desktop and never writes Session history or device credentials on the entry host. History is streamed from the desktop on demand; an optional bounded in-process TTL cache is off by default. Per-session Agent preset selection, live preset updates, and the upstream LAN/pairing protocol are unchanged. The old disk cache remains only behind an explicit --legacy-cache opt-in.
